shortDescription: implements rest api for vlan configuration

options.name: acl_direction
options.description: Direction is which acl to be applied

options.name: acl_id
options.description: Acl policy to be added to vlan

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of acl policy

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: command
options.description: Name of sub module, according to the configuration required.

options.name: config
options.description: To config or unconfig the required command

options.name: helper_addresses
options.description: DHCP helper address for the corresponding VLAN id

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: igmp_version
options.description: Set the IGMP version to use

options.name: interval
options.description: Sets the interval in seconds between IGMP queries

options.name: ip_address_mode
options.description: IP Address Mode to be configured on vlan

options.name: is_dhcp_server_enabled
options.description: Whether DHCP server is enabled

options.name: is_dsnoop_enabled
options.description: Whether DSNOOP is enabled

options.name: is_igmp_enabled
options.description: Enable/disable/configure Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) feature on a VLAN.

options.name: is_jumbo_enabled
options.description: Whether Jumbo is enabled

options.name: is_management_vlan
options.description: Whether vlan is a management vlan or not

options.name: is_querier_enabled
options.description: Specify querier/non-querier capability for the VLAN.

options.name: is_voice_enabled
options.description: Whether Voice is enabled

options.name: last_member_query_interval
options.description: IGMP last member query interval. Value will be ignored if is_igmp_enabled is false.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the VLAN. While creating a Vlan If name is given as empty string, default value (VLANx, where x is the vlan_id) will be configured. Empty string will not be accepted while modifying a Vlan

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: port_id
options.description: Port ID to be configured on the vlan

options.name: port_mode
options.description: Port modes to be configured

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: qos_policy
options.description: Qos policy to be added to vlan

options.name: query_max_response_time
options.description: Set the time interval in seconds to wait for a response to a query

options.name: robustness
options.description: Set the number of times to retry a query

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: status
options.description: the status of the VLAN

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of IP Address (V6 is not supported via REST)

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: vlan id to be configured

options.name: vlan_ip_address
options.description: IP Address to be configured on vlan

options.name: vlan_ip_mask
options.description: IP Mask for the IP Address configured

options.name: vlantype
options.description: The type of VLAN, default being VT_STATIC
